snippet.title: Skilander - Playthrough. No commentary
snippet.description:
As you need to beat all the courses without dying in Rush mode, I decided to take it easy on the final level, as I had already lost too much time in the second level.

Interesting and free game available on Steam:
 https://store.steampowered.com/app/3505250/Skilander/
